ValidationRule.description: If Credit Fraud Team Decline Reason = Other then the agent has to fill Other Credit Fraud Team Decline Reason manually.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Credit_Fraud_Team_Decline_Reason__c), INCLUDES(cc_Credit_Fraud_Team_Decline_Reason__c, "Other"), ISBLANK(cc_Other_Credit_Fraud_Team_Declin_Reason__c), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Credit Limit Increase Application"), ISPICKVAL(cc_Request_Type__c, "permanent") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the Other Credit Fraud Team Decline Reason manually.
